d:
Bihar ke saharsa jile se ek behad rahat bhari khabar samne aaee hai. saharsa pulis ne bihar pulis mukhyalay ke nirdesh par chalae ja rahe 'opreshan muskan' (phej-12) ke tahat bari saphalta hasil karte hue kul 251 khoe aur chori hue mobail phon baramad kie hain.
Aaj guruvar ko saharsa pulis lain sthit mahila bairak men aayojit ek bhavy karyakram ke dauran saharsa ke pulis adhikshak (SP) vikram sihag ne sabhi 251 asli mobail dharkon ko unke phon saunpe. baramad kie gae in mobailon ki kul anumanit kimat lagbhag 60 lakh rupye bataee ja rahi hai.
